---
name: verify
description: Use when a change is about to be committed, or someone asks to verify one. Runs prompts/verify.md — the repo's fast checks (lint, typecheck, the tests the change touches, generated files rebuilt) on the tree being committed, saying what passed, what failed, and what wasn't run.
argument-hint: <nothing for the working tree, or the change to verify>
---

<!-- Claude Code's copy of .agents/skills/verify/SKILL.md, generated by the template's skills:build script; its frontmatter differs by design. Edit the .agents/ file and carry the same change into this one. -->

Run the fast checks exactly as written in `prompts/verify.md`. Read that file in full first; it
is the authoritative instruction set, and this skill only wires it up.

1. **Resolve the change:** the staged and unstaged diff, unless the request names another.
2. **Work through the steps in order.** Commit nothing here; the commit is the caller's.
3. **Report** using the prompt's "Output of this prompt" contract.

Claude Code runs a project skill named `verify` before each commit on its own, except for changes
only to docs or tests (from 2.1.286, as checked on 2026-10-07). It takes the place of the bundled
`/verify`, which builds and drives the app instead; `/run` still launches it.
